intuition: Only a suffix of nines changes; the first earlier non-nine digit absorbs the carry.

brute_force.approach: Convert all digits to an integer, add one, and convert back to digits.

optimal.approach: Walk backward, zeroing nines until a digit can be incremented; prepend one if carry remains.

edge_cases: A non-nine final digit increments directly.
An all-nine number grows by one digit.
